100K experiment · 800-word vocabulary · 128-token context. Replies can be wrong.

PicoBoi is an experiment by @farilyaz in running small language models directly inside a website, on your own device. I’m exploring what they can do with features like web scraping, local memory, calculators, and other small tools. The first 100K model now runs in this page with an 800-word vocabulary. It’s a limited experiment: replies can be wrong, and the extra tools aren’t connected yet.

this ai lives in your browser and nothing is saved
